name: Andrew
bio: John's Gospel records that Andrew was first a disciple of John the Baptist; when John pointed out Jesus as the Lamb of God, Andrew followed Jesus, spent a day with him, and then found his brother Simon and brought him to Jesus, saying, "We have found the Messias" (John 1:35-42). Andrew, a fisherman on the Sea of Galilee and brother of Simon Peter, was called by Jesus to follow him and become a "fisher of men"; he immediately left his nets to do so (Matthew 4:18-20). It was Andrew who pointed out a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish before the feeding of the 5,000, though he doubted it would be enough (John 6:8-9). When some Greeks asked Philip to see Jesus, Philip told Andrew, and the two brought the request to Jesus together (John 12:20-22).
